nodes.summary: Let $c \in \mathbb{C}$, $r > 0$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic on the punctured disc $0 < |z - c| < r$ and not meromorphic at $c$ (that is, $c$ is neither a removable singularity nor a pole of $f$). Then the image of the punctured disc $0 < |z - c| < r$ under $f$ is dense in $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Casorati–Weierstrass theorem

nodes.summary: Let $P \in \mathbb{C}$ and $r > 0$, write $D(P,r)$ for the open disc and $\overline{D}(P,r)$ for the closed disc of center $P$ and radius $r$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic on some open set containing $\overline{D}(P,r)$. If $f$ does not vanish identically on $D(P,r)$, then $f$ has only finitely many zeros in $D(P,r)$.
nodes.title: A holomorphic function not identically zero has finitely many zeros in a disc

nodes.summary: Let $c \in \mathbb{C}$, let $r > 0$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic on the punctured disc $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : 0 < |z - c| < r\}$. Then at least one of the following holds: there is a function $g$ holomorphic on the disc $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z - c| < r\}$ that agrees with $f$ on the punctured disc (removable singularity); or $|f(z)| \to \infty$ as $z \to c$ with $z \ne c$ (pole); or for…
nodes.title: Classification of isolated singularities

nodes.summary: Let $c \in \mathbb{C}$, let $r$ and $R$ be real numbers, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic on the annulus $A = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : r < |z - c| < R\}$. Then there are coefficients $a_n \in \mathbb{C}$ for $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ such that for every $z \in A$ the series $\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a_n (z - c)^n$ is unconditionally summable with sum $f(z)$. Here $0^n = 0$ for $n < 0$, which matters only…
nodes.title: Laurent expansion on an annulus

nodes.summary: Let $s \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be continuous on $s$. Write $u = \operatorname{Re} f$ and $v = \operatorname{Im} f$ as functions of $z = x + iy$, and suppose that at every $z \in s$ the partial derivatives $u_x(z)$, $u_y(z)$, $v_x(z)$, $v_y(z)$ exist and satisfy the Cauchy–Riemann equations $u_x(z) = v_y(z)$ and $u_y(z) = -v_x(z)$. Then $f$ is complex differentiable on…
nodes.title: Looman–Menchoff theorem

nodes.summary: Let $c\in\mathbb{C}$ and $R>0$, and let $S$ be a finite set of points of the open disc $\{z:|z-c|\lt R\}$. For each $s\in S$ let $r_s>0$ be such that the closed disc $\{z:|z-s|\le r_s\}$ lies in $\{z:|z-c|\lt R\}$ and contains no point of $S$ other than $s$. Let $f:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ be complex differentiable on $\{z:|z-c|\le R\}\setminus S$ and integrable on the circle $|z-c|=R$ and on each circle…
nodes.title: Residue theorem on a disc

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be holomorphic on the open upper half-plane $\{z : \operatorname{Im} z > 0\}$, continuous on the closed upper half-plane $\{z : \operatorname{Im} z \ge 0\}$, and real-valued on the real axis. Then there is an entire function $g$ that agrees with $f$ on the closed upper half-plane and satisfies $g(\bar z) = \overline{g(z)}$ for every $z \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Schwarz reflection principle

nodes.summary: Let $f:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ be an entire function and, for $r>0$, let A(r)=\sup\{\lvert f(z)\rvert:\lvert z-r\rvert=r\}. \] Then A(1)^{2}\le A(2)\,A\!\left(\frac{2}{3}\right). \]
nodes.title: A three-circles inequality for circles tangent at the origin

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
